metas.title: HTML meta title for the main blog page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results.
metas.description: HTML meta description for the main blog page. Shown in search engine results below the title. Should describe the blog topics concisely.
metas.title_tags: HTML meta title for a tag-filtered blog page. Shown in browser tab and search engine results. Contains a placeholder for the active tag name.
metas.description_tags: HTML meta description for a tag-filtered blog page. Shown in search engine results. Contains a placeholder for the active tag name.

body.h1: Page heading (H1) for the main blog page.
body.h1_tags: Page heading (H1) for a tag-filtered blog page. Contains a placeholder for the active tag name.
body.lead: Lead paragraph shown below the H1 on the main blog page. One sentence summarizing what the blog covers.

pagination.next: Pagination button label. Navigates to the next page of blog posts. Single word.
pagination.back: Pagination button label. Navigates to the previous page of blog posts. Single word.
